# ZarklyX

> ZarklyX is an all-in-one business management platform that streamlines operations and boosts productivity — social media, projects, finance, HR, CRM and more, for agencies, enterprises and small businesses.

## Solutions

- [Enterprise](https://zarklyx.com/solutions/enterprise)
- [Agencies](https://zarklyx.com/solutions/agencies)
- [Small & Medium Business](https://zarklyx.com/solutions/small-medium-business)
- [Professional Services](https://zarklyx.com/solutions/professional-services)
- [Social Media Management](https://zarklyx.com/solutions/social-media-management)
- [Social Insights](https://zarklyx.com/solutions/social-insights)
- [Brand Awareness](https://zarklyx.com/solutions/brand-awareness)
